material_findings.title: InfraJam 2026 is a near-term AI infrastructure hackathon with a $2,000 advertised prize pool
material_findings.summary: Swift Compute's organizer-hosted InfraJam page advertises a Sep. 19-20, 2026 virtual plus in-person 48-hour AI-infrastructure hackathon with a $2,000 prize pool, four tracks, registration open, and temporary access to H100/A100-class GPU compute. The event is highly time-sensitive and technically relevant to agent/infrastructure work, but the bounded check did not establish complete governing terms, eligibility, exact prize allocation, entry cost, judging criteria, or participant registration acceptance.
material_findings.recommended_action: Keep as a verified lead rather than an active case. Reopen the organizer registration/rules surfaces immediately before any participation decision and preserve eligibility, cost, prize breakdown, judging, submission/IP terms, registration acceptance, and allowed compute/platform use. Build only within organizer-provided competition infrastructure and normal development environments; do not infer security-testing authorization from the event or platform.
